_comment_address: Transparent coinbase address if you later turn on payments; ignored while payments stay disabled.
_comment_zAddress: Private address used only if payments are enabled and shielding is required.
_comment_tAddress: Payout address if payments are enabled; keep different from coinbase address.
_comment_invalidAddress: Invalid miner addresses will be rewritten to this address if set.

paymentProcessing._comment_enabled: Keep false to avoid payouts; pool just relays work to your daemon.

blockSubmission._comment_enabled: Hold block submissions to throttle hash rate for Z15-only pool.
blockSubmission._comment_targetSpacingSeconds: Base target spacing before jitter and difficulty adjustments.
blockSubmission._comment_jitterSeconds: Uniform random +/- jitter added to the target spacing.
blockSubmission._comment_minSpacingSeconds: Never submit a block sooner than this after the last seen block.
blockSubmission._comment_maxSpacingSeconds: Never submit a block later than this after the last seen block.
blockSubmission._comment_maxHoldSeconds: Safety cap on how long a block can be held (must be <= maxSpacingSeconds).
blockSubmission._comment_speedUpStepSeconds: When network difficulty is below difficultyLow, decrease delay by this per block to ramp hash in gently.
blockSubmission._comment_slowDownStepSeconds: When network difficulty is above difficultyHigh, increase delay by this per block to slow hash gently.
blockSubmission._comment_difficultyBounds: Adjust delay +/-1s when block difficulty falls outside this band.

_comment_poolId: Use region code if you run multiple instances.
